regime_context: The detector shows a defensive/healthcare leadership regime: Big Pharma, equal-weight Health Care, Defensives, and Consumer Staples sit at ranks 2–6 with high durability (0.8+) and full breadth, while the absolute-trend gate is eligible for 24/49 themes. Rotation radar is flagging a narrow, non-directional handoff (Memory/HBM rank 1 but ineligible, low durability 0.34, 0% breadth — a hollow leader), with ~49% of themes eligible, indicating a shrinking, quality-over-cyclical tape. Cross-sectional momentum is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0), and the track record shows modest hit rate (56.5%) with weak directional accuracy (41.3%), so leans are kept low-conviction and conditional.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Memory, HBM & Storage (rank=1, score=1.727) becomes trend-eligible — currently eligible=false with durability=0.34 and breadth=0.0, so its rank-1 lead is not confirmed by the staying-power gate. The condition that retires this watch is SMH (proxy) closing above its 50-day moving average with breadth rising above 0.5 and durability re-crossing above 0.6.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the flagged headline theme with the strongest staying-power combination: eligible (trend gate passes), durability 0.83 (high), full breadth 1.0, and confirming trend state (hurst_tag 'trend'). This is the one theme the gate actually validates as a drawdown-control long. Crowding (z=1.42, crowded=true) is a size-down caution, not a fade. The lean is supported by the absolute-trend gate + durability + breadth legs; momentum rank is treated as attention only.
theses.dissent: Crowding is high (z=1.42) and the top rank-1 theme (Memory/HBM) is a loud hollow leader; a risk-off rotation out of crowded healthcare into the still-ineligible cyclical leader could reverse the defensive bid before the check-by date.

falsifier.text: PPH closes below its 20-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Equal-weight Health Care mirrors Big Pharma's staying-power profile: eligible, durability 0.80, breadth 0.95, 'trend' hurst. The broad, equal-weight construction avoids single-name idiosyncratic risk and diversifies the healthcare lead, supported by the same risk-control leg (absolute-trend gate). Crowding (z=1.52, crowded) is again a size-down caution.
theses.dissent: The healthcare complex is among the most crowded in the tape (z=1.5+); if the narrowing rotation (breadth_of_rotation 0.49) continues into cyclical leaders, defensive healthcare could lag even as it remains eligible.

falsifier.text: XLV lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date
